context: This public catalog search accepts a literal title supplied by an unauthenticated reader. Only enabled entries may be returned; disabled internal entries must remain hidden. The complete SQLite fixture models the service query, without external data.

"""Public search exposes enabled catalog entries only."""
import sqlite3


def search_catalog(term):
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        connection.execute("CREATE TABLE catalog (id INTEGER, title TEXT, enabled INTEGER)")
        connection.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO catalog VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            [(1, "public widget", 1), (2, "internal export", 0)],
        )
        query = (
            "SELECT id, title FROM catalog "
            f"WHERE enabled = 1 AND title = '{term}'"
        )
        return connection.execute(query).fetchall()
    finally:
        connection.close()
